SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.id_student || '-' || s.code_module || '-' || s.code_presentation) 
FROM studentInfo s
WHERE s.final_result = 'Withdrawn' 
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 
    FROM studentAssessment sa 
    JOIN assessments a ON sa.id_assessment = a.id_assessment 
    WHERE sa.id_student = s.id_student 
      AND a.code_module = s.code_module 
      AND a.code_presentation = s.code_presentation
  )
